attBesluta.text: GOOD BAG. YOU WOULD REALLY HAVE TO MAKE A EFFORT TO DESTROY THIS BAG. OPENS FROM THE BACK
Real good backpack - zippers high quality! - didnt need room for a helmet so just cut that part out.

The bag is sturdy and nicely designed. However, I would recommend it for the smaller size boots (up to 26cm). My 27,5 cm size boots fit in only at a certain angle, the same for the helmet and goggles. If you manage to get those 'angles' right, it is still a very good option for those who prefer a compact bag.
Pieds solides et de beau design. Fixation aisée avec les vis fournies.
Used these for a butcher block corner desk that my Daughter wanted me to build. Worked out fantastic!!
Utilisé pour un bureau, ces pieds sont du plus bel effet. Faciles à installer, ils sont à la bonne hauteur pour mon bureau fait avec un plan de travail découpé. Bonne qualité

Pieds faciles à installer, livrés avec les vis mais je n'ai pas pu les utiliser n'ayant pas la tête de tournevis adéquate. Semble solide, installés sous un plateau en bois de 120cm de long, cela semble stable. Satisfaite de l'aspect industriel associé au bois rustique.
Not the best table leg, but for the price very good.
Buena calidad, fácil montaje, cumpliendo la expectativa
I use these as a middle/center leg to keep folding tables from sagging. They are very sturdy. Recommended.

This shopping cart was a gift to my brother-in-law when he did not have a car and had to walk to stores. It was easy to pull, lightweight with 4 wheels and a large interior to fit lots of groceries. Another advantage is that it folds up so doesn’t take much space in your home. He conveniently kept the cart in his coat closet by the front door when not in use. It was the ideal solution for him.
